notes.title: February Development Updates
notes.content:
Hello friends!

Hope you’re all having a great start to February! Your support means so much to us and we wanted to share development updates on some cool things we've been working on for Wish Upon A Llama:

[list]
[*] We started a Twitter page! Check us out! [url=https://twitter.com/WishUponALlama]here[/url]
[*] A visual makeover for numerous buildings and areas
[*] An improved placement system
[*] We’re working on our website
[*] New breedable pets (thank you all for the wonderful animal ideas)! We’ve shared the capybara already and will be sharing the other new animals soon! 
[*] Additionally, we're deep in testing and resolving bugs! Stay tuned if you’re interested in helping with our beta testing! 
[*] A complete revamp of player and NPC animations, portraits, and a new diverse wardrobe of clothing and hairstyles! 
[/list]

If you haven't checked these out already, we're also active on our [url=https://www.instagram.com/wishuponallama/?hl=en]Instagram[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/WishUponALlama]Twitter[/url] and Threads accounts! A massive thank you again for your support! 

- Millionhare Studios
